collection.title: Toyota Verso Verso-S 2010 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Toyota Verso-S 2010 Onwards model which requires a 28" wiper blade. This model uses the Hook type wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Verso-S which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
